tickets.title: Update recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Update Daria Copperwisp's recurring IRA distribution instruction at Velvet Acorn Custody to increase the net monthly payment sent to her existing Teacup Comet Bank checking account from $4,500 to $6,200.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to implement the increase by 2025-07-11.

tickets.title: Complete retirement income bridge review
tickets.text: Complete the retirement income bridge review for Daria Copperwisp and Owen Copperwisp, reflecting Daria's recent retirement from Moonbadger Design Works and Owen's consulting income pattern, and determine whether monthly withdrawals should come from the IRA, the joint taxable account, or cash reserves.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that review by 2025-07-25.

tickets.title: Process one-time taxable account distribution
tickets.text: Process an $18,000 one-time distribution from Daria Copperwisp and Owen Copperwisp's joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody for the family tuition contribution, which must clear before granddaughter Nora Copperwisp's school orientation at Cloudberry Kite Academy.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to process the distribution by 2025-07-18.

tickets.title: Obtain health insurance premium documentation
tickets.text: Obtain Daria Copperwisp's current marketplace health insurance premium notice to verify the monthly spending estimate used for withdrawal planning.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the documentation by 2025-07-09.

tickets.title: Check federal withholding instruction
tickets.text: Check the federal withholding instruction on Daria Copperwisp's IRA distributions at Velvet Acorn Custody, since she recalled electing a higher rate than the custodian record shows, before the revised payment is entered.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to check the withholding instruction by 2025-07-15.

tickets.title: Review distribution processing timetable
tickets.text: Review the IRA distribution processing timetable for Daria Copperwisp after the most recent payment posted later than the normal household bill cycle, requiring her to move cash from savings to avoid an overdraft.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review the distribution processing timetable by 2025-07-10.

tickets.title: Prepare funding plan for scheduled withdrawals
tickets.text: Prepare a funding plan for Daria Copperwisp and Owen Copperwisp's scheduled withdrawals that avoids unnecessary realized gains, using the taxable account cash and short-term bond sleeve above the household reserve target.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that funding plan by 2025-07-22.
